newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Baghdad accuses U.N. arms inspection teams of violating sanctity of Iraqi universities.
- Saudi agriculture and water minister announces the setting up of a Saudi agricultural marketing company with a capital of 500 million riyals.
- Qatar Islamic Bank posts a 50 million riyal net profit in 1996.
- Kuwait's new national democracy gathering postpones meeting until next week.
- Iran's earthquake death toll rises to more than 2,000.
- United Arab Emirates studies allowing foreign banks to open branches in the country.
- Kuwaiti finance minister describes fluctuation in the Kuwaiti market as a price correction.
- Price war between insurance firms in Abu Dhabi emirate might cut their 1997 net profit.
